question: What portion of the homa is offered as tarpana after havana?
premises: Tarpana equals tenth part of homa.
inference: After havana, one tenth of the homa is used for tarpana, then the ritual proceeds.
uncertainties: Exact ritual referent of havana is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: After the havana, one tenth of the homa is offered as tarpana; then the ritual continues.
